**Date:** Thursday, October 8, 2026

**Prerequisite:** Power Circuits Questions 1-6

Use a powered-off desktop, labelled cutaway, exterior PSU nameplate, proper computer power schematic, calculator, GUESS, and Google Docs equation tools. This mission does not include operating-system installation or hardware changes.

::: {.callout-important title="Safety boundary"}
Never open the PSU or probe energized internal components.
:::

## Mission sections

1. Identify and photograph or label the power source, conductors, protection, controls, loads, PSU, motherboard, CPU, RAM, storage, and cooling fans.
2. Explain parallel branches, the power button as a control input, the sealed PSU boundary, and the difference between rated and present power.
3. Complete six computer-specific questions with proper subscripts, units, full GUESS work, significant figures, and answer sentences.
4. Complete a short ready-to-power inspection without installing an OS or altering hardware.
5. Submit the completed document, labelled image, all responses, final-answer table, and reflection.
